title: Retired model tickets
author: Kai Moreno
content:
# Purpose
How Support handles tickets about models that Redwood has retired.

# Retired models
- `rw-chat-3` (retired 2026-08-01)
- `rw-embed-1` (retired 2026-06-30)

Calls to a retired model fail with HTTP 410 and error code `model_retired`.

# What Support does
When a customer reports errors from a retired model:
- add the label **model-retirement**
- set assigned_team to **Eng Platform** (the platform team owns migration guidance)

Do not issue credits for retirement errors.
